cv_text:
## Primary CV
ROB VOTO
[TITLE - TAILOR TO JD]
Sydney, NSW | Baseline Security Clearance
rob.voto.au@gmail.com | 0491 982 547
linkedin.com/in/robertohernanvoto
PROFILE
I build AI tools, not just work adjacent to them, and apply that directly to enterprise delivery: discovery, requirements, workflows, stakeholder alignment, system design.
Most BA roles sit on one side of the AI divide. I've built enough to work across both.
[1-2 lines: sector/domain credibility relevant to THIS JD. No years, no clearance. Depth of enterprise context, industry verticals, scale of programs. Tailor per role, never use a fixed line here.]
AI & INNOVATION
knowMe - Live LLM-powered platform built to let recruiters interrogate experience dynamically. FastAPI backend, RAG architecture, structured STAR-based knowledge base. Live now: https://knowme-reeo.onrender.com/
Job Intelligence Tool - Python + Playwright + LLM pipeline for automated job discovery, role matching against profile, and decision filtering across multiple job boards. Cuts hours of manual searching to minutes: https://github.com/robvoto/job-hunter-agent (Prototype working)
Workflow Automation Prototype: End-to-end ticket creation and resolution system built from scratch. Automated routing, ownership assignment, SLA tracking, and escalation logic. AI-driven automation rules reduce manual intervention and improve resolution time.
KEY SKILLS
• LLM Applications (OpenAI / Claude / Codex)
• Agentic AI / Workflow Orchestration
• Prompt Engineering & RAG
• Requirements for AI Systems
• Business Rules and Validation
• Solution Design and Gap Analysis
• REST API / Integration Analysis
• BPMN 2.0 Process Modelling
• User Stories and Acceptance Criteria
• Stakeholder Engagement
• Agile / Scrum Delivery
• SQL, ETL and Data Analysis
EXPERIENCE
Department of Employment and Workplace Relations (DEWR)
Senior Business Analyst
2025 to Present | Contract
Payment system transformation for two national employment programs. Defined business rules, system logic, and delivery artefacts for a fixed go-live deadline.
Taking complex policy docs and legacy system behaviour, turning them into payment rules, validation logic, and field-level data mappings
Translated ambiguous stakeholder inputs into clear, agreed requirements and artefacts
Producing BPMN models, user stories, and Gherkin acceptance criteria to support both policy sign-off and engineering delivery
Working directly with SQL against core data structures in the absence of an admin interface
Using AI tooling (Copilot) to accelerate artefact creation, validate rules, and resolve edge cases
Led the workstream end-to-end from initiation through delivery
Key Achievement: Brought structure to a complex payment program, aligned stakeholders across policy and engineering, delivered on time. Then owned the second program end-to-end.
Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS)
Senior Business Analyst
2024 | Contract
Defined financial data capture and processing logic for a cloud-hosted platform supporting national statistical reporting.
Owned and prioritised delivery backlog in Azure DevOps
Defined data rules and edge cases for financial data collection
Supported REST API testing and data validation using Postman across integrated systems
Facilitated backlog refinement (Miro), aligning policy intent with engineering execution
Key Achievement: Turned complex reporting policy into structured system rules
NSW eHealth / Department of Health
Senior Business Analyst
2021 to 2023 | Contract
Five concurrent government programs: $50M SSE network transformation (15 LHDs), $33M NSW Ambulance relocation, digital health mobile platform, aged care financial management solution.
Produced BPMN 2.0 process models, RTMs, BRDs, and functional specifications across infrastructure and application programs
Redesigned P1/P2 incident workflows for NSW Ambulance. Documentation adopted as permanent team onboarding reference material
Coordinated $50M SSE transformation across 5 vendors, 15 LHD directors, 10 internal stakeholders
Key Achievement: Operated as lead BA across 5 concurrent government programs simultaneously.
Phoenix DX
Senior Business Analyst and Scrum Master
2020 to 2021 | Permanent
End-to-end Agile delivery on OutSystems low-code platform across multiple concurrent client engagements.
Led BA and delivery for Serco Group recruitment and employee management platform - workflow configuration, messaging, and legacy system integration
Managed Agile delivery for GPT Group rent relief system including Salesforce integration
Configured and executed automated test suites using Selenium and Cucumber; managed test lifecycle in OpenText ALM
Key Achievement: Mastered OutSystems from scratch; delivered multiple end-to-end solutions across government, FMCG, and non-profit in a single engagement.
Rockstar Coders
Scrum Master / Business Analyst
2016 to 2020 | Contract (United States)
Consulting BA and delivery lead across 15+ client accounts spanning web, mobile, SaaS, and process improvement.
Led delivery of the Tony Robbins Breakthrough mobile app across BA, Scrum Master, and Product Owner roles
Translated business requirements into workflows, user stories, and system behaviour across multiple concurrent client projects
Produced BPMN 2.0 models to define and optimise complex processes, including 10+ models for a US university scholarship foundation
Operated across BA, Scrum Master, and Product Owner roles depending on client and delivery needs
Key Achievement: Improved Breakthrough app rating from 2.9 to 4.9 while coordinating delivery across distributed teams
EARLIER CAREER
Mastercard | NSW Dept. of Education | Adaptra / Guidewire | Frucor Suntory
Built client-facing platforms and J2EE middleware at Mastercard. Led data migration, ETL, and SQL analysis for the $160M NSW Education LMBR transformation across 2,200 schools. Delivered Guidewire PolicyCenter/ClaimCenter at Adaptra. Led SAP/EDI order-to-cash integration at Frucor Suntory. Developer-to-BA progression across all roles.
EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS
Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology - CAECE University, Argentina
Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) - PMI
Certified Scrum Master (CSM)
Certified Expert in Project Management - UTN Postgraduate Course
BPMN 2.0 Business Process Modelling Certificate
Associate Reactive Developer - OutSystems (2021)
Guidewire Policy and Claim Centre Certified (2010)
